$$

$$

| --- | --- | --- |
| $u$ | $0$ | $1$ |

Let's rewrite our integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int_{0}^{7} \frac{16}{\sqrt{98 - x^{2}}}\,\text{d}x &= \int_{0}^{7} \frac{16}{\sqrt{98(1-\frac{x^{2}}{98})}}\,\text{d}x \\ &= \frac{8 \sqrt{2}}{7}\int_{0}^{7} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1-\frac{x^{2}}{98}}}\,\text{d}x \\ &= \frac{8 \sqrt{2}}{7}\int_{0}^{7} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1-(\frac{\sqrt{2} x}{14})^{2}}}\,\text{d}x\end{aligned}
$$

This integral resembles the basic integral for inverse sine,

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1-(u)^{2}}}\,\text{d}u=\operatorname{arcsin}(u)+C.
$$

The only difference is that instead of ${u}^{2}$ as the variable, we have $(\frac{\sqrt{2} x}{14})^{2}.$

So, let's substitute $u=\frac{\sqrt{2} x}{14}.$ Differentiating, we get

$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{14}\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\text{d}x=7 \sqrt{2}\,\text{d}u.
$$

Before substituting, we use the table below to change the limits from $x$ to $u.$

| $x$ | $0$ | $7$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $u$ | $0$ | $\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$ |

Using the above, we can now write the integral in terms of $u$ and evaluate:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int_{0}^{7} \frac{16}{\sqrt{98 - x^{2}}}\,\text{d}x &= \frac{8 \sqrt{2}}{7}\int_{0}^{7} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1-(\frac{\sqrt{2} x}{14})^{2}}}\,\text{d}x \\ &= \frac{8 \sqrt{2}}{7}\int_{0}^{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1-(u)^{2}}}\cdot (7 \sqrt{2})\,\text{d}u \\ &= 16\int_{0}^{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1-(u)^{2}}}\,\text{d}u \\ &= \left[16\operatorname{arcsin}(u)\right]_{0}^{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}} \\ &= 16\operatorname{arcsin}(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2})-(16\operatorname{arcsin}(0)) \\ &= 4 \pi-(0) \\ &= 4 \pi\end{aligned}
$$

| $x$ | $0$ | $\frac{3}{4}$ |
| --- | --- | --- |

$$

Let's rewrite our integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int_{0}^{1} \frac{18}{x^{2} + 3}\,\text{d}x &= \int_{0}^{1} \frac{18}{3(1+\frac{x^{2}}{3})}\,\text{d}x \\ &= 6\int_{0}^{1} \frac{1}{1+\frac{x^{2}}{3}}\,\text{d}x \\ &= 6\int_{0}^{1} \frac{1}{1+(\frac{\sqrt{3} x}{3})^{2}}\,\text{d}x\end{aligned}
$$

 

This integral resembles the basic integral for inverse tangent,

$$
\int \frac{1}{1+(u)^{2}}\,\text{d}u=\operatorname{arctan}(u)+C.
$$

The only difference is that instead of ${u}^{2}$ as the variable, we have $(\frac{\sqrt{3} x}{3})^{2}.$

So, let's substitute $u=\frac{\sqrt{3} x}{3}.$ Differentiating, we get

$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\text{d}x=\sqrt{3}\,\text{d}u.
$$

Before substituting, we use the table below to change the limits from $x$ to $u.$

| $x$ | $0$ | $1$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $u$ | $0$ | $\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}$ |

Using the above, we can now write the integral in terms of $u$ and evaluate:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int_{0}^{1} \frac{18}{x^{2} + 3}\,\text{d}x &= 6\int_{0}^{1} \frac{1}{1+(\frac{\sqrt{3} x}{3})^{2}}\,\text{d}x \\ &= 6\int_{0}^{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}} \frac{1}{1+(u)^{2}}\cdot (\sqrt{3})\,\text{d}u \\ &= 6 \sqrt{3}\int_{0}^{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}} \frac{1}{1+(u)^{2}}\,\text{d}u \\ &= \left[6 \sqrt{3}\operatorname{arctan}(u)\right]_{0}^{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}} \\ &= 6 \sqrt{3}\operatorname{arctan}(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3})-(6 \sqrt{3}\operatorname{arctan}(0)) \\ &= \sqrt{3} \pi-(0) \\ &= \sqrt{3} \pi\end{aligned}
$$

$$

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1-(u)^{2}}}\,\text{d}u=\operatorname{arcsin}(u)+C.

$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=1\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\text{d}x=1\,\text{d}u.
$$

Before substituting, we use the table below to change the limits from $x$ to $u.$

| $x$ | $-1$ | $1$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $u$ | $-1$ | $1$ |

$$
\begin{aligned}\int_{-1}^{1} \frac{18}{\sqrt{75 - 75 x^{2}}}\,\text{d}x &= \frac{6 \sqrt{3}}{5}\int_{-1}^{1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1-(x)^{2}}}\,\text{d}x \\ &= \frac{6 \sqrt{3}}{5}\int_{-1}^{1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1-(u)^{2}}}\cdot (1)\,\text{d}u \\ &= \frac{6 \sqrt{3}}{5}\int_{-1}^{1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1-(u)^{2}}}\,\text{d}u \\ &= \left[\frac{6 \sqrt{3}}{5}\operatorname{arcsin}(u)\right]_{-1}^{1} \\ &= \frac{6 \sqrt{3}}{5}\operatorname{arcsin}(1)-(\frac{6 \sqrt{3}}{5}\operatorname{arcsin}(-1)) \\ &= \frac{3 \sqrt{3} \pi}{5}-(- \frac{3 \sqrt{3} \pi}{5}) \\ &= \frac{6 \sqrt{3} \pi}{5}\end{aligned}
